seoTitle: Squid Game Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Squid Game test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Gi-hun, the Front Man, Sae-byeok, Sang-woo, Il-nam, Hyun-ju, Thanos or Ali — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the soft-hearted underdog, the cool strategist, or the one who trusts nobody? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle money, trust and pressure, and find out which Squid Game character you are.

characters.name: Seong Gi-hun
characters.title: The Soft-Hearted Underdog
characters.summary: You make terrible choices with money, and great ones with people.
description: Like Gi-hun, you're a mess with a good heart. Player 456 was a chauffeur buried in gambling debts, still living with his mum and struggling to be a good dad to his daughter.
You're impulsive and a bit of a dreamer, but you can't stand to see someone treated unfairly. In the games, he kept choosing to help people, even when it would have been easier not to.
Your weakness is that you trust too easily and act on emotion. But when you finally decide something is wrong, nothing will stop you trying to fix it.
characters.flaw: You act on feelings and hope the rest works out.
characters.signature: Betting your last few notes on a long shot, then giving the winnings away.
characters.clashReason: they make every decision with their heart and expect you to follow

characters.name: The Front Man
characters.title: The Rule Enforcer
characters.summary: Cool, controlled and impossible to read. You believe in the rules, and you enforce them.
description: Like the Front Man, you keep everything under control. He's the masked man in black who runs the games, and his rule is that everyone is equal while they're playing.
You're disciplined, patient and very private. He watches from his room with a glass of whisky while an old record plays, and almost nobody knows who he really is.
Your problem is how cold you can seem. You keep your feelings locked away so well that people wonder if you have any at all.
characters.flaw: You hide your feelings so well that people stop trying to reach you.
characters.signature: A black mask, a glass of whisky and "Fly Me to the Moon" on the record player.
characters.clashReason: they never show what they're thinking and treat rules as more important than people

characters.name: Kang Sae-byeok
characters.title: The Lone Survivor
characters.summary: Quiet, tough and self-reliant. You don't trust easily, but when you do, it's for life.
description: Like Sae-byeok, you look after yourself because you've had to. Player 067 escaped from North Korea and was saving to bring her mother over and get her little brother out of an orphanage.
You're quick, resourceful and hard to fool. She was a pickpocket who didn't bother with small talk and didn't want anyone's help.
But once someone gets past the wall, you're fiercely loyal. The friendship she built with Ji-yeong is one of the show's most heartbreaking.
characters.flaw: You push people away before they can let you down.
characters.signature: Keeping to the corner of the room, watching everyone, trusting no one.
characters.clashReason: they keep everyone at a distance and won't let you help

characters.name: Cho Sang-woo
characters.title: The High Achiever
characters.summary: Clever, ambitious and very practical. You'll do what it takes to come out on top.
description: Like Sang-woo, you've always been the smart one. Player 218 was the pride of his neighbourhood, top of his class at Seoul National University — before he secretly lost his clients' money and ended up hunted by the police.
You're logical and you keep your head when everyone else panics. He was the first to work out what each game meant and how to beat it.
But your pride can't handle failing, and when it comes down to it, you put yourself first. Sang-woo tricked a player who trusted him completely to survive the marbles game.
characters.flaw: When it's you or them, it's always you.
characters.signature: Working out the winning move while everyone else is still reading the rules.
characters.clashReason: they'll smile and team up with you, then pick themselves when it counts

characters.name: Oh Il-nam
characters.title: The Playful Old Soul
characters.summary: Curious, cheerful and a bit mysterious. For you, life is best when it's a game.
description: Like Il-nam, you never really grew up — in the best way. Player 001 was the oldest person in the games, an old man with a brain tumour who seemed delighted just to be playing.
You're curious about people and love the childhood games everyone else has forgotten. His game of marbles with Gi-hun is one of the most famous episodes of the show.
But you're far sharper than you let on. People who treat you as harmless tend to find out later that you were watching them all along.
characters.flaw: You treat serious things like a game, and people get hurt.
characters.signature: A bag of marbles and a warm smile that hides more than it shows.
characters.clashReason: they treat everything like a game, even when it isn't

characters.name: Cho Hyun-ju
characters.title: The Protector
characters.summary: Brave, calm and tough as nails. When people are in danger, you step up.
description: Like Hyun-ju, you're the person people want next to them when things go wrong. Player 120 was a sergeant in the Special Forces before she was forced out of the military for being a transgender woman.
You're practical and steady under pressure. She kept her head when everyone else was panicking, and she was always ready to fight for the people around her.
You have a strong sense of fairness and you stand up for people who can't stand up for themselves. You just find it hard to let others look after you for a change.
characters.flaw: You carry everyone else and forget about yourself.
characters.signature: Standing between the danger and the people who can't fight it.
characters.clashReason: they'll push you to be braver than you want to be

characters.name: Thanos
characters.title: The Chaotic Showman
characters.summary: Loud, cocky and never boring. You'd rather be the centre of attention than play it safe.
description: Like Thanos, you're all confidence. Player 230 was a rapper with purple hair who joined the games after losing everything on a failed cryptocurrency.
You love an audience and you're never short of something to say. He turned every moment in the games into a performance.
Your problem is your ego. You take big risks, you trash-talk everyone, and when things go wrong it's always somebody else's fault.
strengths: Never afraid to take a risk
characters.signature: Showing off to a crowd that didn't ask for it.
characters.clashReason: they're loud, cocky and always need to be the centre of attention

characters.name: Abdul Ali
characters.title: The Loyal Friend
characters.summary: Kind, trusting and hard-working. You see the best in people — sometimes too much.
description: Like Ali, you're the kindest person in the room. Player 199 came to South Korea from Pakistan and worked in a factory, but his boss stopped paying him for months.
You're polite, hard-working and loyal. In the very first game, he caught Gi-hun as he stumbled and saved his life.
Your weakness is trusting people who haven't earned it. He believed in a friend completely, and paid for it. But fans loved him because he never stopped being good.
characters.flaw: You trust people who don't deserve it.
characters.signature: Catching someone before they fall, then politely saying it was nothing.
characters.clashReason: they trust people way too easily, and you'll be the one worrying

questions.text: A cash machine gives you double the money you asked for. You...

options.text: Tell the bank straight away. It's not yours
Tell the bank... eventually, after a long think about your rent
Keep it. The bank never did anything for you
Film it and post it. This is great content

questions.text: You're losing a board game badly. You...

options.text: Keep playing. It's more fun when you don't care who wins
Quietly work out the one move that can still win it
Start trash-talking to throw everyone off
Stick to the rules exactly, win or lose

questions.text: A co-worker keeps getting picked on by the rest of the team. You...

options.text: Tell them to back off, right now
Stick up for them, even if it costs you
Stay out of it. It's not worth the risk
Quietly check they're OK afterwards

questions.text: It's pouring with rain and you're stuck indoors all weekend. You...

options.text: Dig out old board games and get everyone playing
Throw a party. Rain's no excuse
Do a hard home workout, then read
Enjoy it. Nobody's going to come knocking

questions.text: You owe a friend money and you're behind on paying it back. You...

options.text: Avoid them and hope for a lucky break
Tell them the truth and take extra shifts to pay it back
Act like everything's fine. Nobody can know you're struggling
Wouldn't happen. You never borrow from anyone

questions.text: You want a new hobby that's just for you. You go for...

options.text: Martial arts. You like being ready for anything
Target shooting. It takes patience and a steady hand
Writing and recording your own songs
Something slow and old-fashioned, like kite flying

questions.text: Someone you just met is really friendly and wants to team up. You...

options.text: Say yes. Most people are good
Keep your distance until they prove themselves
Team up, but keep your own plan to yourself
Why not? You're curious what kind of person they really are

questions.text: Your team is about to lose a big competition because of one person's mistake. You...

options.text: Say it was partly your fault too, so they're not alone
Keep everyone calm and come up with a new plan
Accept it. Results are results
Make sure everyone knows whose fault it was

questions.text: You find out a competition you entered was rigged. You...

options.text: Go public. People deserve to know
Report it quietly and make sure whoever cheated is thrown out
Work out how to use it to your own advantage
Keep quiet and look after yourself

questions.text: A friend asks you to put money into a "guaranteed" investment. You...

options.text: Put in everything. Go big or go home
Say no. If it sounds too good to be true, it is
Put in a little, just for the fun of the gamble
Say yes. You trust them

questions.text: You're one of hundreds of strangers in a deadly contest for a huge cash prize. The next round is played in pairs. You pick...

options.text: Whoever nobody else wants to pick
The smartest person there
Whoever's left. You'd rather not get attached
Someone strong. Feelings don't win games

questions.text: You're in a deadly contest because your family badly needs the money. The players can vote to stop and all go home with nothing. You vote...

options.text: Keep going. Everyone agreed to the rules
Stop, and try to get others to vote with you
Keep going. Your family is counting on you
Whichever way makes it more interesting
